tools.name: forecast_by_address
tools.description: Get probabilistic home value forecasts for a US street address. Returns P10/P50/P90 bands, appreciation %, reliability score, and 5-year fan chart. Best coverage: Houston metro area.

tools.name: forecast_by_parcel
tools.description: Get lot-level probabilistic forecasts by county tax parcel account number. Coverage: Florida statewide + Houston metro. Returns P10/P25/P50/P75/P90 fan chart across 1-5 year horizons.

tools.name: forecast_by_tabblock
tools.description: Get sub-neighborhood probabilistic forecasts by US Census tabulation block GEOID20 (15 digits). Coverage: NYC (32K tabblocks) and Houston metro (34K tabblocks). Highest geographic resolution available.

tools.name: forecast_by_tract
tools.description: Get neighborhood-level probabilistic forecasts by US Census tract GEOID20 (11 digits). Coverage: Florida + Houston via jurisdiction model; all ~82K US tracts via ACS nationwide model. Useful for cross-market analysis.

tools.name: forecast_by_zcta
tools.description: Get ZIP-level probabilistic forecasts by 5-digit ZCTA. Coverage: ~20,000 ZCTAs nationwide via ACS model with 6-year horizon (0-72 months). Use this for quick cross-market ZIP-level comparisons.

tools.name: forecast_by_unit
tools.description: Get unit-level forecasts by assessor account. Finest resolution - individual condo units, SFRs, townhouses. Use include_siblings=true to get all units in the same condo building. Coverage: Florida + Houston.

tools.name: forecast_by_county
tools.description: Get county-level probabilistic forecasts by 5-digit FIPS. Nationwide coverage. Good for market-level analysis.

tools.name: forecast_by_state
tools.description: Get state-level probabilistic forecasts by 2-digit FIPS. All 50 US states. Use for macro market selection.

tools.name: forecast_by_zip3
tools.description: Get ZIP3-level forecasts (first 3 ZIP digits). 6,210 areas nationwide. Mid-size geography between ZCTA and county.

tools.name: forecast_by_h3_cell
tools.description: Get neighborhood-level forecasts by H3 hex cell ID at resolution 8. Houston metro only. Prefer forecast_by_tabblock or forecast_by_tract for new integrations.

tools.name: get_permit_zoning_readiness
tools.description: Get permit, zoning, energy, and public-record data readiness metadata. Use this before building permit/zoning markets or agent workflows; it reports verified R2 evidence, gaps, and whether raw rows are exposed.

tools.name: get_census_bps_county_monthly
tools.description: Query normalized Census Building Permits Survey county-month rows from Worldcastr's public R2-backed permit surface. Use this for independently verifiable county permit totals, monthly settlement checks, and builder/market data workflows.

tools.name: get_fast41_projects
tools.description: Query normalized FAST-41 federal permitting project inventory rows from Worldcastr's public R2-backed permit surface. Use this for project status, sector, agency, state, and location filters; do not use it for milestone-date settlement until the full FAST-41 dataset is normalized.

tools.name: get_epa_echo_npdes_sewer_overflows
tools.description: Query normalized EPA ECHO NPDES current sewer overflow and bypass event rows from Worldcastr's public R2-backed environmental permit surface. Use this for public event context by permit, state, year, event type, volume, and coordinates; add refresh/checksum policy before autonomous settlement.

tools.name: get_epa_echo_npdes_outfalls
tools.description: Query normalized EPA ECHO ICIS-NPDES outfall, facility, permit-status, and compliance context rows from Worldcastr's public R2-backed environmental permit surface. Use this for public construction stormwater, wastewater, waterbody, permit-component, and current-violation screening; full ICIS limits,

tools.name: get_epa_echo_npdes_sewer_overflow_history
tools.description: Query normalized EPA ECHO NPDES all-version sewer overflow and bypass event rows from Worldcastr's public R2-backed environmental permit surface. Use this for public amendment/replacement history by permit, state, year, event type, volume, current-report flag, and replacing payload IDs; add refresh/

tools.name: get_epa_echo_npdes_violations
tools.description: Query normalized EPA ECHO ICIS-NPDES non-effluent violation rows from Worldcastr's public R2-backed environmental permit surface. Use this for permit-schedule, compliance-schedule, and single-event violation context by permit, state, year, violation code, RNC status, and linked-enforcement counts; f

tools.name: list_benchmark_datasets
tools.description: List Worldcastr benchmark and public-data assets. Returns release phase, support level, benchmark role, and the recommended public surface for each asset.

tools.name: get_benchmark_dataset
tools.description: Get the catalog entry for one Worldcastr public-data or benchmark asset by asset_id. Use this to discover the right REST path before calling vintages, backtests, or source manifests.

tools.name: get_public_forecast_vintage
tools.description: Retrieve validated public forecast vintage rows, starting with the Arizona OEO Maricopa 2022 county-control fixture. Every row carries provenance and benchmark-only labeling.

tools.name: get_backtest_scores
tools.description: Retrieve public-safe benchmark score summaries such as model-vs-persistence tables. Returns asset IDs, artifact IDs, model version labels, and per-target score rows.

tools.name: list_data_assets
tools.description: List the canonical Worldcastr data-asset catalog across public, metadata-only, restricted, and unavailable rows. Use this to discover the full standardized surface, not just currently launched endpoints.

tools.name: get_data_asset
tools.description: Get one canonical data-asset record by asset_id. Returns surface coverage, canonical contracts, provenance, access policy, and related artifact or provenance links.

tools.name: list_data_sources
tools.description: List original data sources used, staged, or reviewed for Worldcastr panels. Returns official outbound source URLs, source tier, source status, panel links, license status, and public readiness.

tools.name: get_data_source
tools.description: Get one original data source by source_id, including official outbound URLs, source family, panel links, provenance metadata, and access policy.

tools.name: get_panel_lineage
tools.description: Get the source-to-panel lineage for a canonical panel. Returns source roles, join keys, transforms, output fields, and official source URLs.

tools.name: get_data_coverage
tools.description: Summarize source, panel, source-to-geography index, and coverage-map posture across the source inventory. Returns counts by tier, status, family, geography, resolution, license status, panel lineage, coverage geometry role, native-boundary status, and top coverage-map regions.

tools.name: list_source_coverage_index
tools.description: List source-to-coverage geography index rows. Returns one row per source with coverage feature IDs, declared geography, coverage geometry role, reference boundary IDs/names when available, native-boundary review status, official URLs, and geometry redistribution policy.

tools.name: list_public_records_acquisition
tools.description: List metadata-only public-records acquisition evidence lanes. Returns durable cloud evidence, public-route checks, records-law gate posture, holdbacks, and next safe action without exposing raw payloads or send-ready request copy.

tools.name: get_source_coverage_map
tools.description: Return the public source coverage GeoJSON layer used by the interactive docs map. Features carry public reference boundaries or generalized selection regions, associated source IDs, official upstream URLs, panel links, readiness, license metadata, and geometry notes.

tools.name: list_data_schemas
tools.description: List canonical Worldcastr schema contracts from the public schema bundle. Use this to discover dataset, provenance, panel, forecast, benchmark, and artifact contract IDs.

tools.name: get_data_schema
tools.description: Get one canonical schema definition by schema_id, including its JSON Schema definition and the data families or assets that reference it.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get canonical metadata for one geography entity such as a tract, county, ZCTA, state, or tabblock. Returns normalized IDs, labels, parent hierarchy, and source asset links.

tools.name: get_geography_crosswalk
tools.description: Resolve canonical geography crosswalk rows such as tract-to-county, tract-to-state, tract-to-ZCTA, or tabblock-to-tract mappings.

tools.name: get_provenance
tools.description: Get one reviewed provenance manifest or source ledger by provenance_id. Returns retrieval and publication metadata, benchmark role, summary counts, and any public-safe details.

tools.name: get_data_artifact
tools.description: Get metadata for one reviewed public artifact by artifact_id. Returns format, media type, owner asset, retrieval metadata, and the canonical download path.

tools.name: get_forecast_vintage
tools.description: Get one canonical public forecast vintage by vintage_id. Returns grouped same-vintage public forecast series with provenance-heavy labeling for benchmark use.

tools.name: get_benchmark_result
tools.description: Get one canonical benchmark result by benchmark_id. Returns standardized score rows, evaluation cutoff metadata, reproducibility references, and benchmark-only labeling.

tools.name: get_county_outlook
tools.description: Get the published county outlook metrics for a 5-digit county FIPS code.

tools.name: list_benchmark_sources
tools.description: List reviewed public benchmark source manifests and their provenance metadata.

tools.name: list_training_runs
tools.description: List the published training-run history and cost metadata with optional jurisdiction and year filters.

tools.name: get_analytics_events
tools.description: Get published aggregate product-event statistics with personally identifying fields removed.

tools.name: get_api_status
tools.description: Get the current published Worldcastr API health status.

tools.name: get_api_usage
tools.description: Get usage statistics for the active Worldcastr API identity.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_benchmark_dataset" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get the catalog entry for one Worldcastr public-data or benchmark asset by asset_id. Use this to discover the right REST path before calling vintages, backtests…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_data_sources, get_data_source, get_panel_lineage, list_source_coverage_index, get_source_coverage_map · Private data: get_permit_zoning_readiness, get_data_asset, list_public_records_acquisition · Public sink: list_public_records_acquisition · Destructive: get_data_artifact, list_training_runs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_data_sources, get_data_source, get_panel_lineage, list_source_coverage_index, get_source_coverage_map · Private data: get_permit_zoning_readiness, get_data_asset, list_public_records_acquisition · Public sink: list_public_records_acquisition · Destructive: get_data_artifact, list_training_runs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
